# hivelocity_vps_iso (Data Source)

Looks up a VPS ISO image, for example by `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_vps_iso" "rescue" {
  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["systemrescue"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.

### Read-Only

- `bootable` (Boolean) Whether the image is bootable.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `device_ids` (List of Number) VPS instances the ISO is attached to.
- `facility_code` (String) Facility.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `iso_id` (String) Unique ID of the ISO.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `ready` (Boolean) True once downloaded.
- `size` (Number) Size.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `url` (String) Source URL.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
